searchText: We lost finality since epoch 9632 geth just pushing changes to their master branch, and new images being rolled out, it only last 2-3 epochs quickly recovers its a bit wild that geth sometimes rolls back 30k blocks when it restarts its great that geth supports 30k block reorgs in the first place ;) Are [those](https://github.com/ethpandaops/fusaka-devnets/blob/master/ansible/inventories/devnet-4/group_vars/all/images.yaml) the most up to date images we can use for Kurtosis testing? Some clients don't seem to work for me. For now I've examined only Prysm BN, in which I get: ``` Caused by: Unexpected error occurred starting service 'cl-1-prysm-geth' Caused by: An error occurred starting the user service container for user service with UUID 'dc9434beec66495f9ab8395b47527aa4' Caused by: An error occurred checking if container '6220b045757b12ef3f48175b62a21bdfe9f0fa0efcd9b37f0265bfe1ece4846d' is running Caused by: Container '6220b045757b12ef3f48175b62a21bdfe9f0fa0efcd9b37f0265bfe1ece4846d' (with image 'docker.ethquokkaops.io/dh/ethpandaops/prysm-beacon-chain:fusaka-devnet-3') die with a non zero exit code rapidly after it was started. This likely indicates a misconfiguration with how the container was started. Container should either exit gracefully or keep running for Kurtosis to consider it in a good state; logs are below: --------------------- CONTAINER LOGS ----------------------- sh: 1: exec: /beacon-chain: not found ------------------- END CONTAINER LOGS -------------------- ``` Can you share with me your kurtosis config? Will try to reproduce. It's a problem with out image. I'm triggering a rebuild now for that tag to include a symlink on /beacon-chain to then point to the right binary. Feel free to pull the `ethpandaops/prysm-beacon-chain:fusaka-devnet-3` image again once this run finishes: https://github.com/ethpandaops/eth-client-docker-image-builder/actions/runs/17467555601 Thanks! <@531934490826768418> probably no need to share the config, given it's not on your end
